steps.instruction: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Rest your arms beside your body and breathe deeply.
Bend your elbows and place your palms flat beside your ears, fingers pointing toward your shoulders. Keep your feet parallel and knees aligned over your ankles.
Press into your feet and lift your hips into Bridge Pose. Then press firmly into your hands to lift your head and chest off the floor.
Straighten your arms and legs as comfortable to arch into Wheel Pose, lifting your chest upward. Hold the pose while breathing steadily and gaze between your hands.

benefits: Strengthens arms, wrists, legs, and spine
Stretches chest, lungs, abdomen, and hip flexors
contraindications: Wrist injury or carpal tunnel syndrome
